_README: Scripted sessions for demo mode. Set SENTRA_DEMO to a key below and /oracle
returns these replies in order instead of calling OpenAI. Everything else in
the system runs for real — the socket relay, the fragment split, both
billboards. Only the model is replaced.
These are TRANSCRIBED FROM THE RCA2025 EXHIBITION, not invented. 'rca2025'
and 'macrame' come off the billboard photographs in the Unit 5 submission;
'medstudent' is the session printed on the session-dossier sheet, the one the
extraction analysis on that sheet refers to. Keep them accurate — the whole
value of demo mode is that the captures are of real sessions.
Replies are served by turn index. If a session runs out, the last reply
repeats rather than erroring, so a capture session cannot break mid-flow.
